scope: TMR NACA 0012 zero-angle SSTm production-definition equation-parity diagnostic

baseline.production: nut times the OpenFOAM deviatoric velocity-gradient contraction

candidate.initialization: same-grid restart from the converged k-only-limiter candidate
candidate.transport: same exact Sutherland viscosity and molecular Prandtl 0.72
candidate.production: P = mu_t times S squared in both equations, with factor-20 limiter only in k

source_evidence.nasa_definition: For SSTm the isotropic rho-k stress is ignored and production is approximated as P = mu_t S squared; the factor-20 limiter applies to the k-equation production term.

report: fraction of the remaining benchmark discrepancy attributable to production definition
decision_rule.benchmark_acceptance: A passing diagnostic does not accept the benchmark by itself; all affected numerical-independence gates must pass with this exact model.
decision_rule.failure_handling: Preserve a failed or nonconverged candidate and do not use its coefficients.
